items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: Howard Reed, Stratoff. I never met him. They tell me he played mellophone, too, and I never heard him.

ctx.x: I can't see who the, uh, is that the owner there next to Johnny Kuhlman? Yeah, man.

They all were Tony. Tony, I mean. I don't know who that trumpet player is. Who the trumpet player? Mm-hmm. I know who it is. A good musician, too. Boy, you know him, too. Who's that? Howard Reed, Stratoff. I never met him. They tell me he played mellophone, too, and I never heard him. Yeah, he's a fine musician. Is he still alive? Yeah, he went for the public service, he's out. He had a good job at the public service.
I always see him all, that's tough man, briefcase in there, you know, Howard Reed.
